regions.text: 交の義、選逅の意にほかならない。

quote.translation: The line (爻) means crossing (交), that is, it means nothing other than Encounter.

regions.text: 繁辭体に「楽人有以見天下之動而親共會通・・是故謂之爻」と云ってるるのは易が天地人生の

quote.translation: When the Xici zhuan says, "The sages had the means to see the movements under heaven and to observe their meeting and interpenetration ....

regions.text: 動の中に動約相對性としての二元の偶然的交叉をその具愛性に於て觀るものであることを逃べてゐる。

quote.translation: therefore these are called lines", it is stating that the Changes observes, in its concreteness, the contingent crossing of two elements (二元), as a dynamic relativity, within the changes and movements of heaven, earth and human life.

regions.text: 「雨儀生四象』といふのは腸爻と腸受老腸三、陰爻と陰爻老陰=）陽爻と陰爻少腸「）陰爻と陽交少陰でとの四通りの偶然的遜遍にほかならない。

quote.translation: "The two modes give birth to the four images" means nothing other than the four kinds of contingent Encounter: yang line with yang line (old yang ⚌), yin line with yin line (old yin ⚏), yang line with yin line (lesser yang ⚎) and yin line with yang line (lesser yin ⚍).

regions.text: プラトンは二と=とを認めたほかに一と一との避遍をば「おめ」（inspiyueos）に起因するものとして認めて都合三通りの迎逅の仕方を逃べてゐるが（PE-ton,Symposium,131-133）二ととの區別には続き及んでるない。

quote.translation: Plato, besides recognising ⚌ and ⚏, recognised the Encounter of ⚊ and ⚋ as arising from the o-me (ἀνδρόγυνος), and so describes three ways of Encounter in all (Platon, Symposium, 191-192), but he does not go on to distinguish ⚎ from ⚍.

regions.text: 易が四通りの組合せの可能性から出發するのは、二元の避逅が指導原理として饅系全確の基礎をなすに足る嚴格性を示してゐる。

quote.translation: That the Changes starts from the possibility of four combinations shows a rigour sufficient for the Encounter of two elements to serve, as guiding principle, as the foundation of the whole system.

regions.text: 「四象生八卦』といふのは四象が再び腸爻陰爻の何れかと遯近して生ずる乾坤震異坎離艮発の入通りの偶然である。

quote.translation: "The four images give birth to the eight trigrams" refers to the eight kinds of chance, Qian, Kun, Zhen, Xun, Kan, Li, Gen and Dui, that arise when the four images in turn Encounter either a yang line or a yin line.

regions.text: 更に入卦と入卦とが偶然相交はつて六十四卦を生ずるのである。

quote.translation: The eight trigrams then cross with the eight trigrams by chance and give birth to the sixty-four hexagrams.

regions.text: 第一爻から第六受まで遯遍に避遍を重ねて大成の卦が成立するのを過卦と稱するに照しても如何に相對的偶然が基礎的意味を有つてるるかがわかる。

quote.translation: In the light of the fact that the complete hexagram (大成の卦), formed as Encounter is piled upon Encounter from the first line to the sixth, is called the "encountered hexagram" (遇卦), we can see how basic a meaning relative contingency has here.

In determining good and ill fortune (吉凶), it is these relative contingencies that carry decisive meaning: which line, yin or yang, chances to fall into each line position of a hexagram, which line comes round to meet which in the two corresponding trigrams, inner and outer, and above all what lands squarely on the "centre" (中) of a trigram, its middle place.
